description: Take control of your life you do not need to control others responses #selflove #selfcare #selenagomez
transcript: Let it go. You don't need an apology and you don't need closure. Stop trying to force people to have a response that they are not going to have. Stop fixating on how people approach situations. That is not for you. Control lies in the way in which you maneuver. Let things go. Stop requiring people to be who you want them to be and become who you are meant to be. Allow your story to continue. You choose the setting, the people, the places, and the things. Stop bringing things from previous chapters to this present moment. Take better control of your life.
